about_the_game:
Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival (Chapter 1)

Welcome to the haunting world of Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival, the first chapter in a psychological horror series. Set in a derelict carnival, this game immerses players in a tense and atmospheric battle for survival.

Key Features

  • Thrilling Chase Gameplay: Evade the relentless pursuit of a terrifying clown while navigating the carnival grounds.

  • Problem-Solving Under Pressure: Fix broken generators, repair electrical boxes, and locate essential tools—all while being hunted.

  • Creative Combat: Outsmart your foe by luring them into traps. Use tools you find to gain the upper hand and survive the night.

  • Dynamic Sanity System: Keep your mind intact by managing your fear and using rare resources to fend off psychological effects.

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Dive into the dark, abandoned carnival, exploring areas like twisted funhouses, eerie tents, and more.

What to Expect

This first chapter offers a standalone horror experience that blends stealth, strategy, and light problem-solving with a tense and unfolding story. Future chapters will expand on the narrative with new threats, environments, and challenges.

Will you survive long enough to uncover the truth?
